prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a square Portra-inspired 35mm interior portrait of an adult woman with long wavy dark-brown hair, light freckles, and minimal natural makeup. She wears a deep burgundy satin long-sleeve midi dress with a modest high neckline and fabric waist tie. Seat her relaxed on a vintage sofa with hands together on the armrest and calm eyes toward camera. Surround her with wood-paneled walls, patterned sofa upholstery, a white textured throw, red velvet cushion, leafy potted plant, and beige fringed floor lamp. Use warm tungsten lamp light, soft shadows, fine grain, natural skin, accurate hands, and tactile fabric and wood detail. No labels, readable text, brand marks, watermark, or sexualized styling.
